en: The train back to Nimbasa City leaves shortly.
Then please take a seat and wait for the doors to close.
The train pulls away from the turntable and runs west through the woods, back toward the lights of Nimbasa...
It's a quiet town. Stay as long as you like, and take a good look at the cars.
The cars here are taking a rest. Come at the weekend, when the whole town turns out to see them.
When the yard's full of people, I swear the trains look happier!
